steps.note: Enable the required PR team filtering configuration before navigating to the requisition list.
Open the Purchase Requisitions screen, the required starting point for a PR-based flow.

args.goal: On the Purchase Requisitions screen, click the Assign person icon next to Upload PRs, search for and select the current PR manager's own name, confirm the self-assignment, then click the top-right bell icon and stop with the notifications panel open.
